Hidden AI Capabilities Can Be Made Cryptographically Undetectable, NeurIPS Paper Proves

AI safety evaluation faces a new mathematical limit: a NeurIPS 2026 paper proves that anyone with access to model weights can embed a hidden neural network protected by SHA-3 cryptography that no known elicitation technique, fine-tuning approach, or weight analysis can surface.
